documents.title: Unaudited Financial Results For Quarter Ended June 30, 2026
Board Meeting Outcome for Held On August 13, 2026
Board Meeting Intimation for Approval For Financial Results For Quarter Ended June 30,2026

analysis.summary: Modison reported its financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2023, showcasing total income of Rs. 1079 Mn for Q3 FY24 and Rs. 2912 Mn for nine months of FY24. Management highlighted robust domestic and global demand for high-voltage and low-voltage products, resulting in sales growth and increasing order inputs. The Board approved an interim dividend of Rs.

guidance.claim: Management expects the business momentum to continue in the foreseeable future.
guidance.quote: We expect the said momentum to continue in foreseeable future led by our continuous engagement efforts backed by continuous improvement in cost and quality improvement.

guidance.claim: Management expects that its ability to execute plans and its financial position will lead to increased success and growth in the long run.
guidance.quote: We expect that our ability to effectively execute our plans and our robust financial position will lead to increased success and growth in the long run.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is experiencing robust demand for high voltage and low voltage products in both domestic and global markets.
demand_outlook.quote: We are seeing robust demand of our product (High voltage and Low Voltage) in Domestic and Global market as well.

demand_outlook.claim: The company observed increasing order inputs from domestic and global customers for high-voltage and low-voltage products during Q3 FY24.
demand_outlook.quote: The Company saw increasing order inputs from the Domestic and global customer in HV and LV products, which results into growth of sales of the Company during the Q3FY24.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced increasing acceptance from Indian and global customers for its products.
demand_outlook.quote: We saw increasing acceptance from Indian and global customers for our products leading to our topline increasing by 21% in Q2FY24.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is observing early indications that customers are looking to transition their supply sources from China to India.
demand_outlook.quote: We are seeing early signs of our customers wanting to shift from China to India as an alternate supply source.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin increased to 8% in Q3 FY24 compared to -1% in Q3 FY23.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin is increased to 8% during the Q3FY24 as compare to -1% in Q3FY23 and PAT margin is increased to 4% during the Q3FY24 as compare to -3% in Q3FY23

margins_costs.claim: Total income for Q2 FY24 was Rs. 973 Mn with an EBITDA of Rs. 97 Mn.
margins_costs.quote:
Total Income was Rs. 973 Mn as compared to Rs, 803 Mn in Q2 FY23
= EBITDA was Rs. 97 Mn as compared to Rs. 25 Mn in Q2 FY23

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that margins improved due to a focus on cost and quality.
margins_costs.quote: Our margins improved on account of cost and quality focus.

margins_costs.claim: The company continues to prioritize cost savings and inventory reduction.
margins_costs.quote: We continue to place emphasis on cost savings, inventory reduction and are fully focused on quality improvement.

orders_capacity.claim: The leadership position in the high voltage business was fortified with marked volume increases.
orders_capacity.quote: Our leadership position in HV business was fortified with volumes seeing a marked increase.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved an interim dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share for the financial year 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: Our Board approved interim dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share for the financial year 2023-24 thereby maintaining our track record of uninterrupted dividend payouts for past 20 years signifying our healthy cash flows.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company experienced a flat topline performance due to fluctuations in silver prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: We saw flat topline due to silver price variations.

management_commitments.claim: The company maintains a track record of uninterrupted dividend payouts for the past 20 years.
management_commitments.quote: Our Board approved interim dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share for the financial year 2023-24 thereby maintaining our track record of uninterrupted dividend payouts for past 20 years signifying our healthy cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects business momentum to continue in the foreseeable future.
management_commitments.quote: We expect the said momentum to continue in foreseeable future led by our continuous engagement efforts backed by continuous improvement in cost and quality improvement.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects that execution excellence and a strong balance sheet will facilitate long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We expect our execution excellence combined with a strong balance sheet will enable us to scale greater heights over the long term.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
